INSERT INTO fault_code_dictionary (company_id, equipment_class, manufacturer, code, description_en, description_es, severity, likely_causes, recommended_action, source, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (NULL, NULL, 'FANUC', 'SV0410', 'EXCESS ERROR (STOP) - positioning deviation for an axis exceeded the limit in parameter 1829 while the axis was stopped. The machine stops immediately, like an emergency stop.', 'ERROR EXCESIVO (PARADO) - la desviacion de posicion del eje supero el limite del parametro 1829 con el eje detenido.', 'HIGH', 'Mechanical binding - a damaged ballscrew, failed linear guide rollers, or a way cover dragging; insufficient or failing servo motor torque; supply voltage sag under load; brake not releasing.', 'Do not simply reset and continue. Check the axis by hand for binding and inspect the ballscrew and guides. An axis that cannot hold position while stopped is a mechanical problem until proven otherwise.', 'SEEDED', now(), now()),
(NULL, NULL, 'FANUC', 'SV0411', 'EXCESS ERROR (MOVING) - following error exceeded the limit while the axis was in motion. Protects against the tool deviating from the programmed path.', 'ERROR EXCESIVO (EN MOVIMIENTO) - el error de seguimiento supero el limite con el eje en movimiento.', 'HIGH', 'Mechanical binding or increasing friction; commanded feed or acceleration beyond what the axis can deliver; servo parameters wrong after a change; failing motor or amplifier.', 'Compare the axis load meter against its normal value for the same program. A gradual rise over weeks is wear; a sudden jump is damage.', 'SEEDED', now(), now()),
(NULL, NULL, 'FANUC', 'SV0401', 'SERVO V-READY OFF - the servo amplifier ready signal dropped while the control expected it.', 'SERVO V-READY APAGADO - la senal de listo del amplificador se perdio.', 'HIGH', 'Amplifier fault; power supply module fault; loose connection between the control and the amplifier; emergency stop chain.', 'Check the amplifier status LEDs and the connection between the control and the drive before replacing anything.', 'SEEDED', now(), now()),
(NULL, 'CNC_DRILL_TAP_CENTER', 'FANUC', 'SP1241', 'SPINDLE OVERHEAT - the spindle motor or amplifier reported an over-temperature condition.', 'SOBRECALENTAMIENTO DEL HUSILLO - el motor o el amplificador del husillo reporto exceso de temperatura.', 'HIGH', 'Blocked cooling airflow; clogged cabinet or spindle cooling filter; sustained heavy cutting beyond duty cycle; failing spindle bearings generating heat.', 'Let the spindle cool and check airflow and filters first. If the temperature climbs again at normal load, treat it as a bearing problem and stop cutting.', 'SEEDED', now(), now());
